title: Architectural Design
short: New homes and buildings, from site strategy to construction drawings.
description: We design new homes from the ground up, reading the site, the sun and the monsoon before anything else. Courtyards, deep verandahs, sloped clay-tile roofs and thick walls are not nostalgia — they are the best climate engineering Tamil Nadu ever had, and we combine them with modern structure, plumbing and kitchens.

process.title: Site & brief
process.text: Survey, constraints, orientation and a written brief agreed together.

process.title: Concept
process.text: Massing studies, sketch plans and a first 3D model of the idea.

process.title: Development
process.text: Plans, sections, materials and structure resolved in detail.

process.title: Delivery
process.text: Technical package, tender support and site visits through completion.

image.alt: South Indian courtyard house with a clay-tile roof and thinnai verandah

title: Luxury Residential Interiors
short: Complete interiors for private homes, with every surface considered.
description: For private homes we design the whole interior as one composition — teak joinery, Athangudi or red oxide floors, brass lighting, oonjal, pooja space and furniture. The aim is a home that feels calm, works for three generations, and still has a place for the grandmother's brass vessels.

process.title: Listening
process.text: How you live, what you collect, what you want to leave behind.

process.title: Direction
process.text: A concept with plans, palette and key pieces.

process.title: Detail
process.text: Joinery drawings, lighting, specifications and samples.

process.title: Installation
process.text: Procurement, site coordination and final styling.

image.alt: Hall with a teak oonjal and cane chairs

title: Commercial & Office Interiors
short: Workplaces that support focus, collaboration and identity.
description: We plan offices and studios around how teams actually work: places to concentrate, places to gather, and the storage, acoustics and light that make both possible. The result should express the organisation without resorting to branding on every wall.

process.title: Observe
process.text: Workshops and observation of current working patterns.

process.title: Plan
process.text: Test fits that balance focus, collaboration and growth.

process.title: Specify
process.text: Finishes, furniture, acoustics and lighting.

process.title: Fit-out
process.text: Drawings, contractor coordination and handover.

image.alt: Office with a long oak table and ribbon window

title: Hospitality & Retail Design
short: Hotels, restaurants and shops with a strong sense of arrival.
description: Hotels, restaurants and shops are judged in the first ten seconds. We design the arrival — pillars, brass light, the smell of jasmine — along with the materials guests touch and the operational details that keep it all working.

process.title: Narrative
process.text: The story of the place, its guests and its operators.

process.title: Planning
process.text: Flows, capacity and service routes.

process.title: Design
process.text: Materials, bespoke pieces, lighting and signage.

process.title: Opening
process.text: Procurement, installation and snagging before launch.

image.alt: Hotel lobby with teak pillars, brass lamps and a brass uruli

title: Renovation & Restoration
short: Careful work with existing buildings — keeping what matters.
description: Many good houses already exist — agraharam homes, Madras-terrace bungalows, Chettinad mansions, 1980s flats. We survey carefully, decide what to keep, repair and remove, and add new work that respects the old. Teak doors get restored; tube lights do not.

process.title: Survey
process.text: Measured drawings, condition and history of the building.

process.title: Strategy
process.text: What to keep, repair, remove and add.

process.title: Design
process.text: New work detailed to sit beside the old.

process.title: Site
process.text: Close supervision — renovation is decided on site.

image.alt: Renovated kitchen under a Madras-terrace roof

title: Space Planning
short: Layouts that make every square metre work.
description: Before tiles and furniture comes the plan. We test layouts against how your family moves through the day, where the breeze and light come from, where the pooja room and kitchen should sit, and what needs storing. Vaastu-aware planning is available on request — we explain the trade-offs honestly.

process.title: Measure
process.text: Accurate base plans and an inventory of needs.

process.title: Options
process.text: Alternative layouts with their trade-offs explained.

process.title: Refine
process.text: The chosen option tested and adjusted.

process.title: Document
process.text: A dimensioned plan ready for design or build.

image.alt: Furnished plan drawing of a Chennai apartment living room

title: 3D Architectural Visualization
short: Real-time models and still images built from the design itself.
description: We build accurate 3D models in Blender and use them for renderings, before-and-after studies and interactive web viewers like the one on this site. You can walk around your thinnai before a single brick is laid.
deliverables: Line drawings exported from the model

process.title: Model
process.text: Geometry built from drawings, organised for reuse.

process.title: Material
process.text: Physically based materials and UV mapping.

process.title: Light
process.text: Daylight, dusk and interior lighting studies.

process.title: Publish
process.text: Renders, drawings and compressed web models.

image.alt: Axonometric drawing exported from the courtyard house model

title: Furniture & Material Consultation
short: Choosing what you touch: stone, timber, fabric, metal.
description: For clients who have an architect or builder but want help with the materials and pieces that define a room, we offer focused consultation: sample boards, furniture selection, and bespoke pieces where nothing suitable exists.

process.title: Brief
process.text: Rooms, budget and the feeling you are after.

process.title: Samples
process.text: Physical and digital boards to compare in your light.

process.title: Selection
process.text: Final pieces and finishes, with lead times.

process.title: Placement
process.text: Delivery coordination and placement on site.

image.alt: Flat lay of stone, timber, ceramic and fabric samples

title: Sustainable Design Consulting
short: Lower-carbon decisions made early, when they matter most.
description: The largest environmental decisions are made in the first weeks of a project: whether to build or adapt, how big, which structure, which materials. We help clients make those choices with evidence, and carry them through to specification.
deliverables: Embodied carbon comparison of key materials

process.title: Baseline
process.text: What exists and what the project could avoid building.

process.title: Compare
process.text: Options assessed for carbon, cost and comfort.

process.title: Decide
process.text: Clear recommendations, recorded in the brief.

process.title: Specify
process.text: Materials and systems carried into the drawings.

title: Design Consultation
short: A focused session to unlock a project or a single room.
description: Not every project needs a full appointment. A design consultation is a structured working session — in person or remote — to review a plan, resolve a difficult room, or set direction before you engage builders.

process.title: Request
process.text: Tell us about the project using the consultation form.

process.title: Prepare
process.text: We review your drawings and photographs in advance.

process.title: Session
process.text: A focused working session, in person or online.

process.title: Summary
process.text: Notes, sketches and recommended next steps.
